record.hypothesis: Across Movies_and_TV, Industrial_and_Scientific, Electronics and CDs_and_Vinyl, untie history and candidate item embeddings at width 64. Initialize the candidate table as a clone of the history table, then train both jointly within each category's single HSTU model. Separating context and target roles may reduce conflicting embedding gradients while preserving initial scores. Keep padding rows zero, frequency features, gated attention, readout, dot-product scoring, loss, optimizer and training settings fixed. Use the candidate table consistently in training, validation and the generated predictor, and checkpoint both tables.

category_rationales.rationale: Untie history and candidate item embeddings in each category's single HSTU model, retaining width 64. Clone the initialized history table into a jointly trained candidate table to preserve initial scores while allowing context and target representations to specialize. Keep attention, frequency features, readout, dot-product scoring, loss and optimizer fixed.
